headline: Executive order signed January 20, 2025, directing that certain places be given or returned to names the order says honor American history.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order changes the official federal names of certain places or landmarks, likely bringing back earlier names. No summary was provided, so the specific places and the exact steps required are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that keep official place names and maps
who_it_affects.how: They would likely need to update the names used in government records, maps, and documents.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2025; the source does not give the effective date.
